query: CHP olağanüstü kurultay çağrı heyeti Sulh Hukuk Mahkemesi başvuru karar - latest status as of late June / early July 2026. Has Özgür Özel's team filed the application under Civil Code Art 75 requesting appointment of a 3-person çağrı heyeti to convene a CHP extraordinary congress? Has any court issued a decision?
answer:
## Summary

**The application HAS been filed, but NO court decision has been issued yet.**

**Key finding:** On **14 July 2026**, Özgür Özel's team filed the application with the **Ankara Sulh Hukuk Mahkemesi** under **Türk Medeni Kanunu (Civil Code) Article 75**, requesting appointment of a **3-person çağrı heyeti** to convene a CHP extraordinary congress (olağanüstü kurultay). An urgent interim measure (acil tedbir) was also requested, with a target of holding the congress within 45 days.

**The trigger:** 833 kurultay delegates (more than two-thirds of all delegates) submitted a notarized extraordinary-congress petition on **17 June 2026**, but the CHP genel merkez did not process the signatures or issue a call — providing the legal basis for the Art. 75 court route.

**Status of court decision:** As of the data cutoff (~14–15 July 2026), **no ruling has been reported by any source**. The matter is pending, with the interim-measure request outstanding, filed just before the 20 July 2026 judicial recess.

**Important note on your timeframe:** Your question asked about "late June / early July 2026." During that window, only the 17 June delegate petition existed — the formal court application had **not yet been filed**. It was submitted on **14 July 2026**. So if a resolution point falls in late June/early July, the answer would have been "not yet filed"; the filing is a mid-July development.

The findings are cross-validated across Medyascope, Bianet, TRT Haber, Hürriyet, Habertürk, Yeni Şafak, Takvim, 10Haber, Gerçek Gündem, Haber7, and Anadolu Ajansı (via Memurlar.net).
